correctness.rationale: Every legal induced extension is realized over the pointwise named chain by universality and homogeneity, and every two realized copies of the same diagram over that base lie in one orbit. The finite list of diagrams exhausts possible tuples, so this also counts complete types. Independently checking the cut proof: within x≺y, comparability requires precisely coordinatewise weak inequalities between the triples (lower cut, linear-order gap, upper cut minus 1). This is the 2×3 rectangular order-map count into 0,…,n, giving the stated C_n by the plane-partition product. For incomparability, write the triples (a,b,c),(d,e,f). The relations are a≤b; b,d≤c,e; e≤f, the extra cross inequality d≤c banning an old-point witness for x◁y. Reverse x◁y is not possible with y≺x fixed in the reversed channel. The incomparable cut poset is the ordinal sum of two three-element posets, each consisting of one relation and a free point. With natural labels 1,2,3 on a,b,d and 4,5,6 on c,e,f, each block has one linear extension without a descent and two with one descent. Sorting cut assignments by value and breaking ties by label gives I_n=binom(n+6,6)+4 binom(n+5,6)+4 binom(n+4,6), equal to the frozen polynomial. T_n doubles by swapping coordinates, and N_n counts a single weakly increasing triple, including n=0. Algebra yields the positive consecutive differences and the two advertised limits. Independent transitive-relation enumeration over all insertions at n=0,…,4 returned C=(1,10,50,175,490) and I=(1,11,60,224,658); replay /workspace/branches/1537464f-18ef-43f3-a568-ffbc992da238/independent_check.py and independent_check_output.txt. Finite replay is not the all-n argument.

What survives is the orientation-refined logical-type census for a named chain, in particular the incomparable channel and resulting quantitative laws in this expanded language. The strongest matched records do not cover that census. This is a best-of-knowledge assessment, not a priority certificate.

value.rationale: Counting possible relations of two elements over a named chain is a natural finite invariant of the ordered homogeneous expansion. The incomparable count and its balance with the comparable count quantify what naming the linear extension changes, including a sharp limiting fraction for uniformly weighted types. This is not an ambient vertex-sampling probability or a claim about arbitrary bases.
